sections.shortTitle: Sindh Shaheed Recongnotion and Compensation Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

Sindh Act No.X of 2017
THE SINDH SHAHEED RECONGNOTION AND COMPENSATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
SINDH ACT NO. X OF 2017.
AN
ACT
to amend the Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014.
Preamble. WHEREAS it is
expedient to amend the Sindh Shaheed recognition and Compensation Act,2014 in
the matter hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement.-- (1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation (Amendment) Act, 2017.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Shaheed Recongnotion and Compensation Amendment Act 2017
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act No. XVI of 2014

Sindh Act No.X of 2017
THE SINDH SHAHEED RECONGNOTION AND COMPENSATION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2017
SINDH ACT NO. X OF 2017.
AN
ACT
to amend the Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014.
Preamble. WHEREAS it is
expedient to amend the Sindh Shaheed recognition and Compensation Act,2014 in
the matter hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Act No. XVI of 2014.--
In the Sindh Shaheed Recognition and Compensation Act, 2014, in section 3, for sub-section (5), the following shall
be substituted:-
(5) Government shall, in addition to the financial compensation under
sub-section (4), appoint two
members of the
family being the
legal heirs of Shaheed person
into service of Government in BS-01 to BS-15 ( except on technical
post or a post to be filled in by promotion) in relaxation of the
conditions of qualification and age, to
the extent as Government may deem
appropriate. .
BY ORDER
OF THE SPEAKER
PROVINCIAL
ASSEMBLY OF SINDH
G.M.UMAR FAROOQ SECRETARY
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY
OF SINDH
